# Pipipi Business Process API

> Versioned Business Process execution API for Memene, Memebuy, and shared product capabilities. Read the complete contract before sending a request.

Base URL: `https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com`

## Agent instructions

1. Read [the complete API contract](https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/docs/api.md).
2. Select an exact `process` and `version` from its Process list.
3. Use `POST /execute` only when the caller accepts synchronous, non-idempotent execution. Use `POST /process-runs` with a stable `Idempotency-Key` when the async interface is available and the operation may be retried. Use the four `/agent-conversations` routes only when the deployment confirms `design-assistant/v1` is enabled.
4. Treat `X-Request-Id` as tracing metadata, never as an idempotency key.
5. For paid image Processes, do not automatically retry an ambiguous synchronous timeout or dependency failure. Follow the retry table in the API contract.
6. A call is complete only after the response matches the documented success or stable error shape. Never infer success from HTTP acceptance alone.
7. For Agent Conversations, create and continue use separate stable `Idempotency-Key` values; follow `Retry-After` on busy or HTTP 429 responses. Never send internal caller or gateway identity headers yourself.

## Documentation

- [Complete API contract](https://pi.ganjiuwanshi.com/docs/api.md): Routes, Process inputs and outputs, asynchronous polling, retry safety, errors, Webhooks, and examples.
- [Human-facing repository documentation](https://github.com/hkai-ai/pipipi/tree/main/docs): Design, development, Process, and operations documentation.

## Boundaries

- Product requests contain business input only. The server selects Skills, models, Tools, providers, storage, retries, and execution configuration.
- Use only exact Process or Agent versions documented in the production catalogs. There is no `latest` alias, default Agent, or version fallback.
- `/internal/eval/execute` is a gated internal evaluation interface, not a general product endpoint.
